dict.string: Viksen reads your heart rate, resting heart rate, workouts and age so the soundscape can respond to how hard you are exercising. Health data stays on your devices and is never shared.
If you turn on weather-aware atmospheres, Viksen uses your approximate location to get the current weather from Apple. Your location is not stored.
Viksen does not write health data from iPhone. Workouts you start in the Viksen Apple Watch app are saved to Apple Health by the watch.
Motion and fitness data lets Viksen follow your head with compatible headphones and respond to walking, running and your step rhythm. It is used on this device only.
The microphone lets you transform the sounds around you into a live, evolving experience. Audio is processed on this device and is never recorded or uploaded unless you choose to record.
